survey: Yellow rounded-square music player, floating and turned three-quarters to the camera. The front face has a large round play button, three small indicator lights and one small round button, all set into the face. A single white cable comes out of a plug at the top-right corner. It arcs up and right, runs down past the right side of the body and curves back under the lower right. Below the player it divides into two short leads, one for each earbud. The two earbuds hang below and face the viewer. The whole object floats against an abstract background, which fits an icon-style card. I could only look at the image at the size it was given; my attempt to crop and enlarge the cable area was blocked, so I couldn't check the split closely.
